tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// maṅga la yab yum gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang phal po che bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs// ༄༅// chos rin po che nye bar bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed kyi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i chu 'dzin las 'ongs legs bshad kyi// thigs pa'i rgyun gyis 'gro ba'i gdung sel zhing*// theg pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho chen po la// thogs med dbang sgyur bla ma klu dbang rgyal// spros med sku yi rnam 'phrul rnam spro zhing*// mi gsung gsung gis smra ngan kun bcom nas// mi rtog rtogs pas lta ngan drungs 'byin pa'i// dgra bcom srid zhi'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyid la// chags sogs bag chags bcas pas ma chags shing*// mtha' dbus dang bral thogs mtha' bar dge ba'i// dam chos dam pa'i 'jug ngogs de la 'dud// dge tshogs dpag med mthu yis dge ba po// dge legs yon tan du ma'i gter 'chang ba// lhar bcas gtsug na gtsug tor bltar mtho ba'i// dge 'dun mi dges mi phyed de la 'dud// gtsang ma'i lha yi bzang po zhes bsgrags pa'i// bskal bzang 'di la bde gshegs stong phrag gi /bzhi par gyur pa shākya'i skyes mchog ste// snying rje'i gzings chen brtson pa'i rlung gis bskyod// skad cig re la'ang bskal mang tshogs bsags nas// ches cher gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro ba la// rab tu brtse bas tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe// shākya'i rigs 'khrungs 'gro ba'i bla mar byon// brgyad cu'i bar bzhugs skye dgu dpag yas pa// mngon mtho nges legs go 'phang mchog la bzhag /thub dbang de ni dbang bcu'i dbang 'byor ba'i// dbang phyug gyur phyir skye 'chi'i dbang mi 'gyur// 'on kyang sku de'i gdul bya rdzogs mkhyen zhing*// gdul byar bya ba gzhan gyis dbang gzigs nas// mi mchog gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur mdzad de// rtag 'dzin gdul bya'i snang ngor zhi tshul bstan// ston pa de yi bstan pa lnga brgya pa// phrag bcur gnas las lnga brgya bdun pa'i dus// 'dzam gling lhun po'i ngos dang nye ba'i phyogs// hor gyi rigs kyi dbang por dbang sgyur ba// mthu dang dpal 'byor che la dbang sgyur ba'i// mi dbang de ni jing gir gan zhes grags// rgyal po de yi rgyal srid yangs pa ni// shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas brtsams gyur nas// 'dzam gling byang phyogs phal cher dbang du byas// de yi sras kyi dam pa ga gan te// rgyal tshab mdzad nas rgyal srid ring du bskyangs// de sras go yug gan zhes rab grags pas// rgyal po'i go 'phang rnam par thob par gyur// de yi yab mched mo go gan yin te// srid la dbang sgyur sa yi bdag por gyur// de tshe gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs bskor ba'i// bod khams chen por thub pa'i bstan pa dar// bstan pa de yi mnga' bdag gcig gyur pa// kun mkhyen gnyis pa skad gnyis smra ba po// sa skya par grags khams gsum chos kyi rgyal// mkhyen rab dbang phyug sa gsum gsal mdzad de// nye dbang dang mtshungs go dan zhes bya bas// nye bar bskul nas shar gyi phyogs su byon// tha dad skad smra'i 'gro ba du ma rnams// bstan pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i sgor bcug nas// so so'i skal bzhin rnam grol lam la bkod// mo go rgyal po'i gcung gyur rgyal tshab ni// go pe la zhes mtshan du grags pa ste// bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis lham pas na// lha min dpal yang zil gnon nus pa des// nyid kyi bden pa'i dpal dang dkon mchog gi

/dpal gyis nag po'i phyogs kyi dpal bcom nas// dkar phyogs rnam par spel ba'i gzi yis ni// 'dzam gling phal cher dbang du mdzad nas bskyangs// de ni ston pa'i bstan pa'i dbang gyur pas// sras yum bcas pas zab dang rgya che'i chos// rab mang gsan cing gsan pa ji bzhin du// nyams su bzhes dang thub pa'i sku gzugs brgya// sras dang slob ma stong gis yongs bskor nas// nye bar bstan pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams dang*// dam chos yi ger bkod pa'i glegs bam khri// rang gis bzhengs dang gzhan dag gis bzhengs pa'i// rtsa lag mdzad cing dge 'dun 'bum phrag snyed// bsnyen bkur nas ni chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /rab tu bskor ba'i spyin bdag mdzad pa sogs// bstan pa'i bya ba shin tu rgya chen mdzad/ rgyal po de la sras mang yod pa las// thu bor gyur pa rgyal sras jim gyim ste// des shing bstan pa'i bya ba nyid la gzhol// gnyis par gyur pa rgyal bu mang ga la// dad dang shes rab phun tshogs bstan la dad// de yi btsun mo puṇ+ḍa rīr bcas pas// sa bdag rgyal po yab kyi sku ring la// yab yum gcen dang bcas pa'i drin bsab cing*// mthar thug kun mkhyen go 'phang thob bya'i phyir// yi ge gser dang brkos sogs bzo rigs la// legs sbyangs da rig la sogs rgya bod sogs// rgyal sras kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// srid zhi'i phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi// 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kun nas bskyed pa'i yum// rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i tshul du gsungs rnams dang*// gzhan yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi// yon tan phrin las zhing dang gdul bya sogs// zab dang rgya che mtha' dbus med ston pa// shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod phal chen bcas// dri med baiḍūr+ya ltar dag pa'i gzhir// shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser las rab tu bzhengs// na bza' la sogs mchod pas rab mchod de// bde gshegs gsung rab tshul bzhin rab gnas bgyis// klog dang mchod la brtson par go cha bgos// de ltar thub pa'i gsung rab dri ma med// bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi thugs kyi gsang*// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mchod pa'i gnas gyur pa// lhag bsam dag pas bzhengs pa las byung ba'i// dge ba dri med tsha zer ltar gsal bas// sgrib pa'i mun nag tshang tshing rab bcom nas// mkhyen pa'i ye shes pad tshal rgyas byas te// 'gro kun legs bshad sbrang rtsis tshim byed shog

/sbyin bdag sras dang btsun mor bcas pa yang*// skye ba kun tu dal 'byor lus thob ste// bde gshegs bde gshegs sras por bcas pa yi// gsung rab rgya mtsho rab tu 'dzin par shog /tshe 'dir tshe ring 'tshe med tshul bzhin 'tsho// tshangs ltar tshul bzhin dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs// bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin grub gyur nas// bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par byed gyur cig /rgyal khams kun kyang dge zhing mu ge med// nad dang 'khrugs long mi dge kun zhi zhing*// skye dgu thams cad dge ba'i las lam spyod// kun nas dge ba'i lha yis legs skyong shog /'di yi gnyer du bskos nas gnyer byed pa// bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang ni thang ngo ta// grogs dang grogs kyi grogs su bcas rnams kyang*// chos kyi dpal gyis dpal 'byor phun tshogs shog /de ltar rgyas sras rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug pas// rgyal ba'i gsung rab ji ltar bzhengs tshul dang*// bsngo ba'i tshig 'di rgyal ba'i chos smra ba'i// dge slong 'phags pas rgyal bu rgyal phyir sbyar// shing mo phag gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la/ tsom mdo gnas sar du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
